title: Pro Shop Store Credit: gifting, credential-replacement and referral terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's gifting and credential facet across every tier: whether that tier may be purchased as a gift for another member, the fee to transfer balance to another member's account, the fee to replace a lost or stolen account credential, whether photo identification is required for that replacement, the one-time bonus credit for referring a new member, and the cap on referral bonuses within a rolling twelve-month window.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Purchasable as a gift | Balance-transfer fee | Lost-or-stolen credential replacement fee | Photo id required for replacement | Referral bonus | Referral bonus cap per rolling year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | Yes | 5.00 USD | 10.00 USD | Yes | 10.00 USD | 4 |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | Yes | 5.00 USD | 10.00 USD | Yes | 10.00 USD | 4 |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | Yes | 5.00 USD | 10.00 USD | Yes | 15.00 USD | 6 |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | Yes | 0 USD | 0 USD | Yes | 25.00 USD | 8 |
| Auto-Reload Standard | No | 5.00 USD | 10.00 USD | Yes | 10.00 USD | 4 |
| Auto-Reload Premium | No | 0 USD | 0 USD | Yes | 20.00 USD | 6 |

## Points of reference
- The two Auto-Reload tiers are the only tiers of this product that may not be purchased as a gift for another member.
- The VIP Credit $500 Tier and Auto-Reload Premium are the only tiers that currently waive both the balance-transfer fee and the credential-replacement fee; every tier still requires photo identification for a credential replacement.
- The referral bonus and its rolling-year cap both scale upward with the tier.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tiers waive the credential-replacement fee entirely?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier and Auto-Reload Premium, each showing 0 USD.
**Does the Value Credit $250 Tier allow more referral bonuses per rolling year than the Standard Credit $100 Tier?** Yes — 6 compared with 4.
